question: In which of the following states did NABARD launch the e-Shakti project for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand and Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **July 2016**, the **National Bank for Agricultural and Rural Development (NABARD) **launched the** ‘e-Shakti Project**' for **digitisation of all Self-help Groups (SHGs)** in the district.
 
• In the **pilot phase**, Nabard had taken up two districts: **Dhule in Maharashtra** and **Ramgarh in Jharkhand**.
